about.p1: Your OpenPak account is your OpenVerse account. There is nothing separate to set up, and no password here: sign-in happens on openpak.org.
about.p2: Posts made on the web, in the OpenPak app and on Wii U and 3DS are one conversation. A drawing you make here is stored in the console's own format, so it shows up on the consoles too.
about.p3: Each game has a community. Follow the ones you play, post in them, and give Yeahs to what you like. Communities and posts follow the community rules and OpenPak's terms.
about.p4: Accounts supervised through OpenPak parental controls can read but not post unless a parent allows it. Anyone can report a post, and moderators remove what breaks the rules.
about.p5: OpenVerse is free software under the AGPL-3.0: github.com/openpak/openverse. Its Wii U and 3DS support builds on Juxtaposition by Pretendo Network (AGPL-3.0). Miiverse is a trademark of Nintendo; OpenVerse is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

welcome.lede: Share posts and drawings with the OpenPak community, from the web, the app, Wii U and 3DS. Please read the community rules (full terms) before you start.
welcome.r1: Be kind. No bullying, hate or harassment.
welcome.r2: Keep it friendly for all ages: nothing adult, violent or disturbing.
welcome.r3: Keep personal details private, yours and other people's.
welcome.r4: No spam, advertising or pirated content.
welcome.r5: Posts that break these rules are removed, and repeat offenders can lose access.
